content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen works (photo, headline, one call link), but the contact block under the hero repeats the header's phone and directions, and the footer repeats them a third time.","desktopNote":"The split hero is solid, yet the primary action is a tiny underlined text link and the vineyard section sits in a wide white band with a huge unrelated landscape photo.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Drop the phone/address block directly under the hero; the header already carries both and the footer repeats them, so leave contact in header and footer only.","Replace the vineyard landscape in the 'Brezplačen ogled' section with a trade photo (heat pump, bathroom, pipework on site) and shrink it so the text no longer floats in empty space.","Turn 'Pokličite nas' into a proper filled button on both screens and tighten the vertical padding of the desktop ogled and 'Kje delamo' sections to remove the dead bands."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop: phone number and directions link appear three times – in the header, in the contact block right below the hero and again in the footer."]}
